description: We’re software engineers building health monitoring software for astronauts. Our offline-first system tracks fatigue, sleep disruption and stress and flags problems without contact with Earth, vital on Mars missions where communication is delayed. We cover backend, frontend and data pipelines and prototype fast. Join us for a clear plan, focused scope and a polished demo. Looking for: a health/biomedical background, a UI/UX designer, an ML/data person, and a strong presenter.
